rubric.role_summary: Growth marketing role leading paid customer acquisition for haircare and skincare across Meta and AppLovin, developing Pinterest and TikTok, directing measurement and testing, and managing a Paid Social Associate.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Growth marketing role leading paid customer acquisition for haircare and skincare across Meta and AppLovin, developing Pinterest and TikTok, directing measurement and testing, and managing a Paid Social Associate.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 4+ years of hands-on experience in paid acquisition or growth marketing.
- Hands-on Meta Ads experience.
- Experience running app or programmatic (DSP) acquisition channels.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience at a DTC or subscription brand.
- Direct hands-on experience operating AppLovin.
- Pinterest and TikTok experience.
- Experience with analytics and reporting tools such as Looker or similar.
- Experience with Haus and Northbeam.
- Deep, hands-on Meta Ads Manager experience sufficient to set strategy and account structure, including experience with purchase- and value-optimized campaigns.
- Experience owning acquisition strategy for an app or programmatic channel, such as AppLovin or a similar DSP.
- Analytical skills in owning measurement, interpreting performance data, and translating it into spend decisions and reporting.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: New York metropolitan area. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
